async: An awaited Promise is a blocking Go call that returns the ClassifierResult; failures are reported in the result like upstream; AbortSignal is the context.Context argument; no detached goroutine.
rationale: classify: the Go Classify function has the ClassifierFunction signature (model, request, options) and is the classifier module registered by the API constructor; the upstream-derived test drives it.
